title: 第九章：一群人渣
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

此时的小杨换了一身漂亮华丽白色纱裙。一层一层的蕾丝花边，可爱的泡泡袖，把她衬托得高贵可爱，让人陶醉。裙子上还镶着些珍珠，还有着粉红的水晶。这华丽的白裙衬着美丽的脸蛋，她就这样站在那一个男子旁，想必那定是她哥哥了。

他走过去对着小杨笑了笑，然后走向小杨的哥哥，伸出手打着招呼。

“你好苏先生，我是雪清的二哥，我叫杨尚远”杨尚远介绍。

“你们两个怎么自己介绍起来了，我这个主角还没说话呢！！”小杨噘起小嘴。

“哈哈！！！”

“哈！谁让你反应那么迟钝的，人家苏先生走来了也不理”杨尚远摸着小杨的脑袋说。

“别动，我发型乱了，每次都这样摸人家头，会变笨的”小杨别开她二哥的手说。

“走吧苏大哥！我们去吃饭，今晚我一定要把今天吐出来的补回来，哼！”

“哈哈！！！”

杨雪清坐着苏南的车，杨尚远开着自己的车跟在后面。二十多分钟后三人坐在苏城洲际酒店。

服务员把菜单递了上来，杨雪清一把抢过来。

“我要这个，这个，还有这个，还有我最喜欢吃的大龙虾，还有战斧牛排，好了，你们点了”

苏行枫和杨尚远相互看了一眼。

“这么多？你确定你能吃得完吗？”他惊讶的问。

“我当然能吃得完，别看我嘴小，但我胃口大啊！怎么？心疼了？”

“没，没有，只是感觉有点不可思议”

“还别说，这丫头从小就这么能吃，但是也怎么都吃不胖，让苏先生你见笑了”杨尚远笑着说道。

“没事，能吃是好事，我就但心会不会吃撑了。杨大哥要吃什么自己点。”

三人中杨雪清吃的是津津有味的，一会就吃完了。他看着她都有点怕了，她这小小的身材能装下这么多食物？

苏行枫吃饭不怎么喜欢说话，所以他也就慢慢的吃着，吃完后在服务员把盘子全收走后，上了饭后甜点。

“哇！终于吃饱了，好爽啊！喔！”杨雪清打了个饱磕，懒懒的坐在那儿说。

杨雪清坐在那自顾自的自己玩起了手机也没离他们两个男人。

“苏先生别介意，雪清从小就这样，无拘无束想到什么就做什么，我这个做哥哥的只要看到她开心就好了，也就随她着的性子了”

“没事，这样很好，真性情。要不然今天我们三也不会坐在这一起吃饭了，呵呵！”

“是啊！缘分嘛。对了，我看苏兄弟像是练过的吧？”

这会儿杨尚远叫他苏兄弟了，他听到这称呼也没在意。

“哦！我啊，我也只是今年刚从部队退伍回来，算是练过吧，呵！倒是我看杨大家应该身手不错吧？”

这段时间他一有时间都会自己回到炎龙部落修炼，也会利用两的边时间差，自己在那边学习各种修炼知识，加上修炼知识和自己本来就有一手，这看人的眼光就更毒了。

“苏兄弟眼睛很毒辣嘛！我这么刻意的隐藏都被你看出来了啊！看来苏兄弟也算是修炼界的人了嘛？”

“修炼界？....我只是一个偶然的机会认识一老头，那老头看我一身筋骨奇特，说我是修炼奇材，这才授我修炼之道，杨大哥，我还真不懂这些事情，我那便宜师傅也没跟我说过，要不你跟我讲讲呗？”

此时的他又开始故事模式，还一股二流子气息嬉皮笑脸的。

“这个,呵呵！苏兄弟太会说笑了，我这是着了你的道了啊！其实我也不是知道的太多，算起来我也只是比你更先一步入门而以，现在我算是引气入体，还差的太远了，只有真正达到筑基才算得上是迈入门槛啊！我们还早呢！”

“这样啊！那还真是难啊！我这都还没引气入体呢！”

“.....”

两人同声相应都是个菜鸟，一见面就聊的胜欢。

“哈哈！我一下就得到这么多的赞了，快你们也帮我点一下。”

At this time, Xiao Yang changed into a beautiful and gorgeous white gauze skirt.Layers of lace and cute puff sleeves make her look noble and lovely, making people intoxicated.The skirt is also studded with pearls and pink crystals.This gorgeous white dress set off her beautiful face. She was standing next to that man, who must be her brother.

He walked over and smiled at Xiao Yang, then walked towards Xiao Yang's brother, stretched out his hand and said hello.

"Hello Mr. Su, I am Xue Qing's second brother, and my name is Yang Shangyuan," Yang Shangyuan introduced.

"Why did you two introduce yourselves? I, the protagonist, haven't spoken yet!" Xiao Yang pouted.

"Haha!!!"

"Ha! Who made you react so slowly? You ignored Mr. Su when he came." Yang Shangyuan touched Xiao Yang's head and said.

"Don't move, my hair is messed up. If I touch someone's head like this every time, I will become stupid," Xiao Yang said as she put her second brother's hand away.

"Let's go, Brother Su! Let's go to dinner. I will make up for what I vomited today tonight, hum!"

"Haha!!!"

Yang Xueqing was sitting in Sunan's car, and Yang Shangyuan was following behind in his own car.More than twenty minutes later, the three of them were sitting at the Intercontinental Hotel in Sioux City.

The waiter handed over the menu, and Yang Xueqing grabbed it.

"I want this, this, and this, and my favorite lobster, and tomahawk steak. Okay, you guys have your order."

Su Xingfeng and Yang Shangyuan glanced at each other.

"So much? Are you sure you can finish it?" he asked in surprise.

"Of course I can finish it. Even though I have a small mouth, I have a big appetite! What? Are you feeling distressed?"

"No, no, it just feels a little weird."

"Not to mention, this girl has been able to eat so much since she was a child, but she can't get fat no matter what she eats. It makes you laugh, Mr. Su," Yang Shangyuan said with a smile.

"It's okay. It's a good thing to be able to eat. I'm just worried about whether I'll be full. Brother Yang can order whatever he wants."

Among the three, Yang Xueqing ate with gusto and finished it in a while.He was a little scared looking at her. Can her small body hold so much food?

Su Xingfeng didn't like to talk much while eating, so he ate slowly. After eating, the waiter took away all the plates and served dessert.

"Wow! I'm finally full. It feels so good! Oh!" Yang Xueqing said after taking a nap and sitting there lazily.

Yang Xueqing sat there minding her own business and played with her mobile phone without leaving the two men.

"Mr. Su, don't mind. Xue Qing has been like this since she was a child. She does whatever comes to her mind without restraint. As a brother, I just want to see her happy, so I can just follow her temper."

"It's okay. This is good. It's really cool. Otherwise, the three of us wouldn't be sitting here eating together today, haha!"

"Yes! It's fate. By the way, I think Brother Su has practiced, right?"

At this moment, Yang Shangyuan called him Brother Su, and he didn't care when he heard the title.

"Oh! Me, I just came back from the army this year, so I have practiced, huh! But I think Mr. Yang is pretty good at it, right?"

During this period, whenever he had time, he would go back to the Yanlong Tribe to practice. He would also take advantage of the time difference between the two to learn various cultivation knowledge there. In addition, he already had a good grasp of cultivation knowledge, which made his judgment on people even more poisonous.

"Brother Su has very vicious eyes! You saw that I was hiding so deliberately! It seems that Brother Su is also a member of the cultivation world?"

"The world of cultivation?.... I just met an old man by chance. The old man saw that I had strange muscles and bones, and said that I was a special talent in cultivation, so he taught me the way to practice. Brother Yang, I really don't understand these things. My cheap master didn't tell me about it. Why don't you tell me about it?"

At this time, he started the story mode again, and he still had a second-rate air and a playful smile.

"This, haha! Brother Su is so good at joking, I've got your way! In fact, I don't know much, so I just got started one step ahead of you. Now I've introduced Qi into my body, but I'm still far away. Only by actually reaching the foundation building can we be considered as stepping into the threshold! We're still early!"

"That's it! That's really difficult! I haven't even introduced Qi into my body yet!"

"..."

The two of them agreed that they were both newbies and chatted happily as soon as they met.

"Haha! I got so many likes right away. Please give me some likes."
